description: An interior of a dim, wood-beamed room with a lit lantern on a table. Around the table sit several men of mixed complexions, some holding papers and a quill, with a few more standing behind them. At the left, uniformed soldiers in tricorn hats and white cross-belts with bayonets push through an open door, one raising a sabre. Through the open window at right, moonlit water shows sailing ships at anchor and distant hills. No visible text.
